metadata.name: montions
metadata.description: Montions: outcome-first binary options with a fully onchain CLOB on Solana

accounts.name: price_update
docs: (the sponsored feed account, or a posted update). Validated in the handler.

errors.name: OrderNotOpen

fields.name: symbol
docs: Ticker, e.g. "SOL". PDA seed: `["asset", symbol.as_bytes()]`.

fields.name: feed_id
docs: Pyth price feed id.

fields.name: price_account
docs: Canonical Pyth sponsored price account (PriceUpdateV2, shard 0) for quoting and settlement.

fields.name: strike_step
docs: Strike grid in 1e-8 USD; every market strike must be a positive multiple of it.

fields.name: vol_bps
docs: Annualised volatility for the maker model, bps (8000 = 80%).

fields.name: max_conf_bps
docs: Max Pyth confidence / price, bps, accepted for quoting and settlement.

fields.name: settle_window
docs: A print is accepted for settlement iff `expiry <= publish_time <= expiry + settle_window`
(or it is provably the first Pythnet print at/after expiry: `prev_publish_time < expiry`).

fields.name: collateral_mint
docs: Collateral mint (devnet: program-owned "tUSDC" PDA mint, 6 decimals, faucet-enabled).

fields.name: maker
docs: Maker PDA (`["maker"]`): owner of the maker's seat in every market.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Maker treasury token account (`["treasury"]`, authority = maker PDA).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Taker fee in bps of taker collateral consumed (<= MAX_FEE_BPS). Makers pay nothing.

fields.name: paused
docs: Pauses NEW risk only (place_order that adds exposure, split, create_market, refresh_quotes).
Cancels, merges, withdrawals, resolution and redemption always work.

fields.name: faucet_amount
docs: Faucet mint per claim (base units) and cooldown between claims per wallet (seconds).

types.name: Level
docs: One price level (FIFO list of resting orders). Indices point into `Market::orders`.

types.name: MakerParams
docs: Parameters of the protocol market maker (an onchain, model-priced quoter; see `maker_model`).

fields.name: enabled
docs: Master switch for `refresh_quotes`.

fields.name: levels
docs: Price levels posted per side (1..=4).

fields.name: level_spacing
docs: Ticks between consecutive levels (>= 1).

fields.name: min_half_spread
docs: Minimum distance in ticks from fair value to the best maker quote on each side (>= 1).

fields.name: max_market_exposure
docs: Worst-case loss budget per market in collateral base units: the maker never escrows more
than this in one market (resting orders + inventory at risk).

fields.name: level_notional
docs: Target collateral per level in base units (actual size is clamped by `max_market_exposure`).

fields.name: min_tte
docs: Stop quoting when time to expiry is below this many seconds.

fields.name: max_price_age
docs: Reject Pyth prices older than this many seconds when quoting.

types.name: Market
docs: A binary market: "is `asset` >= `strike` at `expiry`?". One YES + one NO = 1 UNIT, always
fully collateralised. PDA: `["market", asset, strike.to_le_bytes(), expiry.to_le_bytes()]`.
Accounting (all in collateral base units unless noted):
- `vault.amount == Σ seat.cash + Σ seat.locked + pool + fees` after every instruction.
- `yes_total` / `no_total` count every outstanding claim: SPL supply of the YES/NO mint plus
seat-internal `yes + yes_locked` / `no + no_locked`.
- Open: `pool == yes_total * UNIT == no_total * UNIT`.

fields.name: strike
docs: Strike in 1e-8 USD.

fields.name: expiry
docs: Expiry (unix seconds). Trading allowed while `now < expiry`.

fields.name: settle_price
docs: Settlement price (1e-8 USD) and its Pyth publish time; 0 until resolved.

fields.name: pool
docs: Collateral backing outstanding YES/NO pairs.

fields.name: fees
docs: Accrued taker fees (claimable by admin).

fields.name: volume
docs: Contracts traded (sum of fill quantities).

fields.name: next_order_id
docs: Next order id to assign (starts at 1).

fields.name: bid_bits
docs: Occupancy bitmaps: bit t (t in 1..=99) of the 128-bit value `[lo, hi]` is set iff the level
at tick t is non-empty. `bits[0]` holds ticks 0..=63, `bits[1]` holds ticks 64..=127.

fields.name: status
docs: STATUS_OPEN / STATUS_RESOLVED / STATUS_VOID.

fields.name: outcome
docs: 1 = YES won, 0 = NO won (meaningful only when Resolved).

fields.name: last_trade_tick
docs: Tick of the most recent fill (0 if none).

fields.name: trade_head
docs: Next write position in `trades`.

fields.name: trade_count
docs: Total fills ever recorded.

fields.name: free_head
docs: Head of the free list of order slots (NIL if full). Must be initialised by `engine::init`.

types.name: Order
docs: A resting order. A slot is free iff `id == 0`.

fields.name: id
docs: Sequential per market, starting at 1. 0 = empty slot.

fields.name: qty
docs: Remaining contracts.

fields.name: ts
docs: Placement time (unix seconds).

fields.name: seat
docs: Index of the maker's seat in `Market::seats`.

fields.name: side
docs: SIDE_BID or SIDE_ASK.

fields.name: tick
docs: Limit tick 1..=99.

fields.name: from_held
docs: 1 if the order is backed by held tokens instead of cash:
Ask → escrowed YES (selling YES); Bid → escrowed NO (closing NO, spec A3).

fields.name: prev
docs: Previous / next order in the same level FIFO (NIL = none). When the slot is free, `next`
links the free list.

fields.name: side
docs: SIDE_BID (buy YES) or SIDE_ASK (sell YES).

fields.name: tick
docs: Limit tick 1..=99.

fields.name: qty
docs: Contracts, 1..=MAX_ORDER_QTY.

fields.name: tif
docs: TIF_GTC / TIF_IOC / TIF_POST_ONLY.

fields.name: from_held
docs: Ask: sell YES the caller holds. Bid: close NO the caller holds (spec A3).

fields.name: max_fills
docs: Max resting orders matched or STP-cancelled (0 → DEFAULT_MAX_FILLS).

fields.name: min_filled
docs: Revert unless at least this many contracts fill immediately (slippage / FOK-style guard).

types.name: PlaceResult
docs: Returned by `place_order` (Anchor return data) and by the engine.

fields.name: order_id
docs: Id of the resting remainder (0 if nothing rests).

fields.name: fee
docs: Taker fee charged (base units).

fields.name: cash_out
docs: Amounts the instruction must push back to the taker's wallet after matching.

types.name: Seat
docs: A maker's balances inside one market. A seat is free iff `owner == Pubkey::default()`.

fields.name: cash
docs: Free collateral (withdrawable).

fields.name: locked
docs: Collateral escrowed in resting orders.

fields.name: yes
docs: Free YES / NO contracts (withdrawable as SPL tokens).

fields.name: yes_locked
docs: YES escrowed in from_held Asks; NO escrowed in from_held Bids.

types.name: Trade
docs: One fill, newest at `trade_head - 1` (mod TRADE_RING).

fields.name: taker_is_buyer
docs: 1 if the taker bought YES (lifted an Ask).
